<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ringpos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
def pegs(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; out.append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
    return sorted(out)
print("start ring:",ringpos(current_frame),"pegs:",pegs(current_frame))
for i in range(5):
    action([{'action':'UP'}],intent='explore')
    print(f"UP {i+1}: ring={ringpos(current_frame)} no_impact={last_action_result.get('no_impact')} done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        break
print("final pegs:",pegs(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
